messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  (All dates are in the local time zone for Canada.)

| Holiday | Date(s) | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (​Sun) – observed Mon Jan 2 | The holiday fell on a Sunday, so the next day was a paid day off. |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Fri) | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in most provinces. |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Mon) | Celebrated on the last Monday before May 25. |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Sat) – observed Mon Jul 3 | The holiday fell on a Saturday, so the following Monday was a paid day off. |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Mon) | Always on the first Monday in September. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Mon) | Always on the second Monday in October. |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Mon) | Falls on a Monday, so the weekend is extended. |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 (Tue) | Observed on a Tuesday, giving a three‑day break. |

These are the statutory holidays that created “long weekends” (i.e., a holiday falling on a Friday or Monday, or an observed holiday on a Monday).  If you’re looking at provincial holidays (e.g., Family Day, Civic Holiday, etc.), those would add a few more long weekends depending on the province.
message.reasoning:
The user wants a list of long weekends for Canada in 2023. They want to fetch it. We have a function connectBluetooth but that's irrelevant. There's no function to fetch holidays. So we cannot call any function. We should respond with the data. We can provide the list manually. Let's recall Canadian public holidays that create long weekends. In Canada, long weekends typically include:

- New Year's Day (Jan 1) - if falls on weekday, then preceding or following weekend? Actually New Year's Day is always a holiday; if it's on a weekday, it's not necessarily a long weekend unless it's adjacent to weekend. But many people consider it a long weekend if it's on Friday or Monday.

But the question likely expects official long weekends: e.g., New Year's Day (if on weekend, it's observed on Monday). But we can list all statutory holidays that create long weekends. Let's list major ones:

2023 Canadian holidays:

- New Year's Day: Jan 1 (Sunday) -> observed Mon Jan 2
- Family Day (Ontario, etc.) - but not all provinces. For simplicity, maybe list national holidays only.

National holidays:
- New Year's Day
- Good Friday (varies)
- Canada Day (July 1)
- Labour Day (first Monday in September)
- Thanksgiving (second Monday in October)
- Christmas Day (Dec 25)
- Boxing Day (Dec 26)

Also some provinces have other holidays like Victoria Day (Mon before May 25), etc.

Long weekends: Typically include:

- New Year's Day (if observed on Monday)
- Good Friday + Easter Monday (but Easter Monday is not a holiday in Canada except in some provinces)
- Victoria Day (Mon before May 25)
- Canada Day (if falls on weekend, observed on Monday)
- Labour Day (always Monday)
- Thanksgiving (always Monday)
- Christmas Day (if falls on weekend, observed on Monday)
- Boxing Day (if falls on weekend, observed on Monday)

Let's list them for 2023:

- New Year's Day: Jan 1 Sunday, observed Mon Jan 2
- Family Day: Feb 20 (but not national)
- Good Friday: Apr 7
- Victoria Day: May 22 (Mon)
- Canada Day: Jul 1 Saturday, observed Mon Jul 3
- Labour Day: Sep 4 (Mon)
- Thanksgiving: Oct 9 (Mon)
- Christmas Day: Dec 25 Monday
- Boxing Day: Dec 26 Tuesday

Also there might be "Remembrance Day" on Nov 11 (Friday) but not a long weekend.

So long weekends in Canada 2023:

- Jan 1-3 (New Year's Day observed Mon Jan 2)
- Apr 7-8 (Good Friday & Easter Monday? Actually Easter Monday is not a holiday in Canada except in some provinces. But Good Friday is a holiday; the weekend includes Fri Apr 7, Sat Apr 8, Sun Apr 9. That's a long weekend.)
- May 22-24 (Victoria Day Mon May 22, weekend)
- Jul 3-5 (Canada Day observed Mon Jul 3)
- Sep 4-6 (Labour Day Mon Sep 4)
- Oct 9-11 (Thanksgiving Mon Oct 9)
- Dec 25-27 (Christmas Day Mon Dec 25, Boxing Day Tue Dec 26, weekend)

Also maybe "Remembrance Day" on Nov 11 (Friday) but not a long weekend.

Thus answer accordingly.
